_readme: Fluentify's dictionary, generated by tools/build_lexicon.py. Each shard holds the headwords starting with that two-letter prefix, the inflected forms that resolve to them, and the Persian meanings that can be looked up from Persian. Shard layout: w = headword -> entry, f = form -> headword, p = Persian -> headwords. Entry layout: r frequency rank, p parts of speech, i IPA by region, f inflected forms, s senses as [pos, English definition, Persian meaning, English example, Persian example] (empty string where the source has none), y synonyms by part of speech, a antonyms by part of speech. Nothing here is inferred: a field is present only when the source provided it.
